testsuite.name: com.dopashift.domain.property.SyncPushRetryBackoffPropertyTest

testcase.name: Property 19: For any attempt number N (1-5), backoff delay is exactly INITIAL_BACKOFF * 2^(N-1)
Property 19: Backoff values match exact sequence 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 16000 ms
Property 19: After 5 failed attempts, the system does NOT retry further
Property 19: Queued changes remain in local store after all retries are exhausted
Property 19: For random failure counts (1-5), correct backoff timing is applied before each retry
